## Checks

- [ ] `python3 tools/check.py`, `uvx pytest`, `uvx ruff check .`, `npm run lint`
- [ ] Face changes: `build/shots/<Name>.cmp.png` attached, preview refreshed if the look changed
- [ ] `core/` or `tools/build.py` changes: `shasum dist/*.prg` compared before and after, differing faces listed
